2022_292_oct_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) report for October 2022 was presented to the Board of Education at its December 13, 2022 meeting. The 32-page transaction listing, printed December 7, 2022, itemizes every card charge posted between September 27, 2022 and October 25, 2022, each journalized as OCT PCARD EXP and coded to a budget unit and account code. The report closes with a subtotal of $270,595.25 in transaction amounts, $7,325.92 in the credits column, and Total Expenses of $263,269.33. The single largest charge is $10,939.50 to YMCA CAMP CO in budget unit 700005199704000.
